free_text: The 76-year-old male presents with a significantly elevated PSA of 13.6 ng/mL and a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the mid transition zone, correlating with a confirmed ISUP grade group 1 adenocarcinoma. The clinical stage is cT1c. Given the low-grade cancer and mild LUTS, the management assessment focuses on reviewing individual treatment benefit and patient preferences for active surveillance.
